findings.title: Invalid ERB syntax breaks embed rendering
findings.body: The tag `<%- end if %>` is not valid Ruby/ERB; `end` cannot be followed by a postfix `if` like this. Template compilation raises a SyntaxError whenever this view is rendered, so the embed page will fail once a topic exists.

findings.title: Imported feed/remote HTML is stored and rendered unsanitized
findings.body: `url` is interpolated directly into HTML without escaping and only checked to start with `http(s)://`, so a URL like `http://evil.com/'><script>...` is injectable. The resulting `contents` are stored via PostCreator with `cook_method: raw_html` and then rendered in `embed/best` with `raw post.cooked`, so attacker-controlled feed or imported HTML can execute script in the forum embed context.

findings.title: Missing embed_by_username causes nil.downcase crash
findings.body: `fetch_http` calls `SiteSetting.embed_by_username.downcase` without checking the setting is present. If an embed is requested while `embeddable_host` is set but `embed_by_username` is not configured, the background job raises NoMethodError, so the loading page never resolves. This is an easy misconfiguration and should return or fallback instead of crashing.

findings.title: postMessage targetOrigin uses full referer URL instead of origin
findings.body: `request.referer` is the full embedding page URL (e.g. `http://eviltrout.com/2013/...`), but `Window.postMessage` requires the target origin (`http://eviltrout.com`). Passing the full URL with a path prevents the resize message from being delivered to the parent page, so the iframe height is never updated.

findings.title: iframe URL is malformed when discourseUrl has no trailing slash
findings.body: `discourseUrl + "embed/best?..."` concatenates the path without a separator. If `discourseUrl` is configured as `http://forum.example.com` (no trailing slash), the iframe src becomes `http://forum.example.comembed/best?...`, which fails to load. Use `discourseUrl + "/embed/best?..."` or normalize the base URL.

findings.title: PollFeed crashes on RSS items without content
findings.body: `i.content.scrub` assumes every RSS/Atom item has a `content` member. Many valid feeds only provide `description` or `summary`, so `i.content` is nil and the job raises, and since retry is disabled the entire poll run fails. The parser should use `i.content || i.description || i.summary` or explicitly skip missing content.

findings.title: Throttle key expiration is not atomic with creation
findings.body: `retrieved_recently?` calls `$redis.setnx` and then `$redis.expire` separately. If the process crashes between the two calls, the `retrieved:<url>` key is left without a TTL and the URL is effectively throttled forever. This should be done with an atomic `SET NX EX`-style command or ensure expiration in a Redis transaction.
